cli.serve_readiness.unproven.role: mesh readiness diagnostic, terminal and remote capability detail
cli.serve_readiness.unproven.tone: factual, non-alarming; never imply a PID identity has been proved when it has not
cli.serve_readiness.unproven.note: `lop serve`, `lop services status`, `lop services restart` are literal commands. {device}, {pids}, {holders}, {builds}, {recorded}, {install}, {reasons} are already bounded diagnostic text inserted verbatim when present. {count} is the full daemon count; plural must agree even if the displayed PID list is capped. A recorded build gap is not evidence the current process runs that build. Restart is guarded by its own process/address checks.

cli.serve_readiness.identity_restart.role: mesh readiness diagnostic, terminal and remote capability detail
cli.serve_readiness.identity_restart.tone: factual, non-alarming; never imply a PID identity has been proved when it has not
cli.serve_readiness.identity_restart.note: A current-build unproven RECORD needs no action for this non-required check, but remains unknown, never a claim that the live process runs that build. Restart advice is shown ONLY for a recorded build gap, and never promises that restart proves identity. Automatic reload is suggested only for reloadable records, otherwise by hand. Commands are literal; {device} is bounded device text. A proven stale neighbour already supplies the single restart step.

cli.serve_readiness.pid_reason.role: mesh readiness diagnostic, terminal and remote capability detail
cli.serve_readiness.pid_reason.note: {count} is numeric and selects plural; {pids} is a bounded comma-separated numeric PID list, never English prose. {reason} is an already translated complete diagnosis shared by exactly these PIDs. Localize PID/PIDs and overflow wording; do not repeat diagnoses for each PID.
